lead: Maternal death = death of a woman while pregnant or within 42 days of the end of pregnancy, from any cause related to or aggravated by the pregnancy or its management, but not from accidental or incidental causes.
f: Direct: obstetric complications or their treatment (PPH, eclampsia, sepsis, VTE, ectopic, AFE, anaesthesia) · Indirect: disease made worse by pregnancy (heart disease, anaemia, malaria, HIV) · Late: 42 days to 1 year · Coincidental: accident, violence; not counted · Pregnancy-related death: any cause to day 42

sc: Severe malaria kills a woman at 28 wk → Indirect
Peripartum cardiomyopathy, dies at 4 months → Late maternal death

f: MMR = maternal deaths ÷ live births × 100 000 · Maternal mortality rate: per 100 000 women aged 15–49 · Lifetime risk: Sudan about 1 in 91 · Sources: vital registration, surveys, sisterhood method, confidential enquiries; deaths are under-reported

tr: The MMR denominator is live births, per 100 000 (perinatal mortality is per 1000)

f: For each death many women live with fistula, prolapse, anaemia, infertility, depression · Near miss: nearly died but survived a life-threatening complication; reviewed to improve care

sc: Survives eclampsia and an emergency hysterectomy → Maternal near miss

f: Sudan MMR 256 (298 in 2015) · sub-Saharan Africa 448, about 70% of deaths · World 197, about 260 000 deaths a year · SDG 3.1: under 70 by 2030

Sudan: sepsis, haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, VTE; obstructed labour, unsafe abortion, anaemia · World: haemorrhage (about 27%) · UK, USA: VTE leading direct cause, cardiac disease overall · First-trimester death: ectopic, abortion
Delay 1: deciding to seek care · Delay 2: reaching care · Delay 3: receiving care · Untreated, death in about 2 h with PPH, 1 day with rupture, 2 days with eclampsia, 6 days with sepsis

sc: Reaches hospital, no blood for 3 h → Delay 3

f: Family planning, treat anaemia, girls' education · Antenatal care: 4–8 visits, IPTp and nets · Skilled birth attendant, partograph, AMTSL · EmONC: basic (antibiotics, oxytocics, MgSO₄, manual placenta, MVA, assisted birth, newborn resuscitation); comprehensive adds caesarean and blood · Postnatal checks · Post-abortion care · MDSR: every death reviewed with no blame
